name: Street Construction Permits - Cranes
description:
This dataset lists street construction permits that involve cranes, with one row per crane associated with a permit. Each record includes a permit number, the crane type (such as Main, Main - Mobile, Assist, or Crawler), a crane serial number, and timestamps for when the record was created and last modified. The sample covers 5,000 rows with no missing values in any column.

The data can be used to analyze which crane types are most common in street construction work, track how often specific cranes are used across permits, and examine permit activity over time based on creation and modification dates. It may also support equipment utilization studies, workload planning, or cross-referencing with broader permit or transportation datasets by permit number or crane serial number.
